title: Entity Invoice enforces its tenant-scoped identity, invariant and lifecycle for consumers
risk: A consumer reads or writes Invoice through a path that crosses the tenant boundary or ignores the invariant, so a wrong or foreign record becomes the basis of a customer-facing statement.
preconditions: Tenant T1 seeded in run-t1-unit-ent-invoice with the fixture record for Invoice identified by its business key
A tenant T2 record with an equivalent business key exists so cross-tenant reads can be attempted

inputs.invariant_under_test: an invoice mirrors the ERP document with tax and carrier fields and is never re-issued
inputs.refused_violation: a duplicate invoice_number inside the tenant is rejected
inputs.downstream_consumer_read: the order read exposes invoice AB12345678 for ORD-A-1 with its tax total

steps.action: Read and re-write the Invoice record through the tenant-scoped repository/service using the fixture business key
steps.expected: the record round-trips with tenant_id T1, an immutable id and the business key intact

steps.action: Exercise the consumer path named for this entity
steps.expected: the consumer observes the invariant: an invoice mirrors the ERP document with tax and carrier fields and is never re-issued
the write is rejected with an explicit domain error and leaves no partial row, no orphan child and no side effect (a duplicate invoice_number inside the tenant is rejected)

steps.action: Repeat the read with the T2 tenant scope and with a caller lacking authority for this entity
steps.expected: T1 data is not returned, the T2 copy is unchanged and the denial is recorded rather than silently emptied

assertions: The persisted record carries tenant_id T1 and unique identity under (tenant_id, invoice_number)
The consumer path reflects the invariant: an invoice mirrors the ERP document with tax and carrier fields and is never re-issued
The refused operation returns an explicit error naming the rule, and the prior state is byte-identical afterwards: a duplicate invoice_number inside the tenant is rejected
The T2 read returns no T1 row and the T1 read returns no T2 row
forbidden: Accepting the refused operation, or applying it partially before the error: a duplicate invoice_number inside the tenant is rejected
Returning, joining or counting another tenant's row on any consumer path of Invoice
evidence: Repository read/write responses for both tenants including the business-key and tenant_id fields
Error code and message of the refused operation plus the unchanged row snapshot taken before and after
cleanup: Delete the run-scoped Invoice rows and their child rows under run-t1-unit-ent-invoice; keep the fixture and the denial audit entry
automation: Drive the repository/service API with the fixture payloads and assert on the returned projection, the error code of the violation and the cross-tenant read; the entity contract is enforced at the service boundary, so no DDL introspection is needed.
